about: GMod workshop player models picked for conversion to CS2 (create/playermodels). chosen=true: in the batch. mdl: the registered model converted (path inside the item). Workshop authors keep their rights; many GMod player models are themselves ports from other games, so converted models are for private/local testing unless the author agrees to more (see docs/creation/gmod-playermodels.md).
